entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment:
Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category I and II  
The reduced rate only applies to 
- draught horses, heavy and medium weight in 0101 2100, 0101 2990
- deers in 0106 1900
- domestic pigeons in 0106 3910
- animal blood whether or not dried in 0511 9985

entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment:
Domestic rabbits, pigeons, hares, partridges, pheasants, frogs and other live animals intended for human consumption.
Only if intended for human consumption

entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment: Tabel I prov. a.31 and b.1: certain braille products; clocks, optical reading devices, TV magnifiers, reading platforms, orientation aids, support, tactile and recognition canes designed for personal use of blind and partially sighted persons; guide dogs; other aids designated by ministerial regulation that have been specially designed for exclusive and personal use by blind and partially sighted persons; reading pens and other equipment with similar function, equipment for use by dyslexics.

entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment: Food, including beverages, intended for human and animal consumption, live animals and poultry of domestic species, except alcoholic beverages, non-alcoholic beverages NC 2202, foods with added sugar, whose total sugar content is at least 10g/100g product, other than milk formula for newborns, infants and young children, food supplements defined by Law No. 56/2021: art. 291 para (2) lett. b) of Fiscal Code and point 37 (4)-(4^3) of Norms.
